title: Dependence-Informed Sparse Neural Architecture for Stock Return Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.14323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Using neural networks for stock return prediction typically requires choices about depth and hidden-layer width that are difficult to connect to financial interpretation. We study an alternative: estimate dependence among firm characteristics with a Maximally Filtered Clique Forest (MFCF), then map its clique structure to a Homological Neural Network (HNN). The MFCF maximum clique size K is the only parameter controlling architectural complexity, and it has a clear graphical meaning: it bounds the number of characteristics in each maximal clique and hence the highest interaction order the network can represent. The filtered graph then fixes the neural network's depth, layer widths, and sparse connections before training, in place of a separately chosen depth and width sequence. translated_title: 基于依赖信息的稀疏神经架构用于股票收益预测
translated_abstract: 使用神经网络进行股票收益预测通常需要选择深度和隐藏层宽度，这些选择难以与金融解释联系起来。我们研究了一种替代方法：使用最大滤波团森林（MFCF）估计企业特征之间的依赖关系，然后将其团结构映射到同调神经网络（HNN）上。MFCF的最大团大小K是唯一控制架构复杂性的参数，并且它具有清晰的图形意义：它限制了每个最大团中的特征数量，从而限制了网络能够表示的最高交互阶数。滤波图随后在训练前固定神经网络的深度、层宽度和稀疏连接，取代了单独选择的深度和宽度序列。我们将两种HNN变体应用于1987年至2016年美国股票超额收益的年度样本外预测，使用94个企业特征。HNN模型匹配了一个t（此处截断，但根据上下文，可能指匹配基准性能）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于依赖信息的稀疏神经架构，通过最大滤波团森林（MFCF）将特征依赖结构映射到同调神经网络（HNN），仅用一个参数K控制架构复杂度，在股票收益预测中达到与基准匹配的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dependence-informed sparse neural architecture that maps feature dependence via a Maximally Filtered Clique Forest to a Homological Neural Network, using a single parameter K to control complexity, achieving benchmark-matching performance in stock return prediction.
